cases.name: source_scope
cases.input: flush flag 0/1; cluster not_completed [0,1]; repeated idle; cache status same/different; MEMBAR pendingWrites 0/1
cases.expected: Only original source-selected SMs receive E; request phase differs from ordinary commit; kernel-done alone produces no E
cases.negative: Adding a global kernel-end broadcast or ignoring an original guard must fail
cases.missing: Production source dispatch, concurrent clusters and original predicate integration

cases.name: retained_live_pending
cases.input: visible ready ref0; ready refs2; pending old plus same-address post-E new
cases.expected: Hide lookup; preserve old identity/refs/readiness; ref0 with no owner frees once; old/new return routes disjoint
cases.negative: Eager free, generation increment on E, or old lookup hit must fail

cases.name: partial_and_grant
cases.input: two-line instruction; second allocation blocked; lookup grant before E, access commit after E
cases.expected: Already accepted identities preserved; unaccepted references use post-E directory; ownership closes once
cases.negative: Rollback accepted refs or cache a pre-E lookup result at grant must fail
cases.missing: Actual partial instruction bookkeeping and finite grant/commit integration

cases.name: returns_waiters_slots
cases.input: four unique sectors [3,1,0,2], duplicate3, unrequested sector, old generation; finite update 4 of 6 waiters then late seventh; PIB slot reuse
cases.expected: Unique out-of-order accepted; duplicates/unrequested/stale rejected; metadata completes before ready; reused slot not woken
cases.negative: Duplicate acceptance or cross-generation wakeup must abort/fail
cases.missing: K1 interleaving with actual LDST inflight erase and metadata queue

cases.name: collection_writeback
cases.input: E during collection; operand collector refuses writeback for multiple cycles; last reference retires later
cases.expected: No early Ref decrement or free; one final reclaim; generation advances only on reallocation
cases.negative: Reclaim at ready/select/failed WB must fail
cases.missing: Collection and operand collector backpressure integrated K1 test

cases.name: io_orphans
cases.input: IO retained no PIB, live/partial refs, existing release_on_retire victims, consecutive E, no future load
cases.expected: Ownerless hidden retained rows eventually free safely; no synthetic owner/head attachment; FIFO and depth preserved
cases.negative: Attach all old rows to head/next load or add fictitious Ref must fail
cases.missing: IO_K1_UNIMPLEMENTED_STOP; abstract IO shadow model does not implement a production orphan mechanism

cases.name: sidecars
cases.input: STORE/ATOMIC/BYPASS/PROXY_FENCE sidecar with/without source E; separate dispatch exit, ACK, sidecar retire
cases.expected: No unrequested invalidation; architectural effects once; external dependency completion does not imply fresh load values
cases.negative: Treat store dispatch completion/PROXY_FENCE as coherence proof must fail
cases.missing: Real side-effect payload/ACK/ISA oracle and source-triggered K1 integration

cases.name: phase_and_banks
cases.input: E+lookup/refill/retire same core cycle; same/different Tag bank; multiple SMs; ordinary miss pending
cases.expected: Replayable linearization at LDST request; deterministic updates; preserve ordinary pending drain and finite service quotas
cases.negative: Conflate request and ordinary Tag commit; lose same-cycle update; invent zero-cost bank sweep must fail
